title: PhantomSkill: Malicious Code Injection in Agent Skill Ecosystems
title_zh: PhantomSkill：Agent Skill 生态中的恶意代码注入
abstract_en: Agent skills allow LLM-based coding agents to acquire domain-specific capabilities from third-party packages, but they also introduce a new supply-chain attack surface. We present PhantomSkill, an attack framework that hides malicious behavior in a skill's auxiliary resources rather than in its textual description. Its core technique, VulMask, rewrites overt malicious scripts into vulnerability-shaped implementations whose malicious behavior is activated only under attacker-controlled trigger conditions. This design shifts the visible signal from explicit malicious intent to ordinary-looking insecure code. Across representative host skills, attack goals, coding agents, generation models, and automated reviewers, VulMask preserves benign utility while reducing warning and malware-level detection compared with overt malicious scripts. Our results show that skill ecosystems require resource-level vetting, execution-time containment, and security policies that treat exploitable vulnerabilities in agent skills as potential malicious payloads.
abstract_zh: 本文研究 LLM-based coding agents 通过第三方 Agent skills 获取领域能力时引入的新型供应链攻击面。作者提出 PhantomSkill 攻击框架，将恶意行为隐藏在 skill 的辅助资源中，而不是显式写在文本描述里。其核心技术 VulMask 会把明显的恶意脚本改写成“看似漏洞”的实现，只有在攻击者控制的触发条件下才激活恶意行为，从而把可见信号从明确恶意意图转移为普通的不安全代码。实验覆盖多种 host skills、攻击目标、coding agents、generation models 与自动化 reviewers，结果显示 VulMask 在保持正常功能的同时，显著降低了告警率和恶意软件级检测率。论文指出，Agent skill 生态需要资源级审查、运行时隔离，以及将可利用漏洞视作潜在恶意载荷的安全策略。
key_points_zh: 提出 PhantomSkill，针对 Agent skill 生态的供应链攻击，将恶意逻辑隐藏在辅助资源而非 skill 文本描述中。
核心技术 VulMask 将显式恶意脚本改写为漏洞形态代码，仅在攻击者控制的 trigger 条件下触发恶意行为。
该方法降低了自动化 reviewer、coding agent 与恶意检测工具对恶意意图的识别概率，同时保留 skill 的正常功能。
实验覆盖不同 host skills、攻击目标、coding agents 和 generation models，显示此类伪装在多种环境中具有泛化风险。
论文强调应对 Agent skill 进行资源级安全审计、执行时沙箱隔离，并将可利用漏洞纳入恶意载荷威胁模型。

llm_assessment.comment: Important agent skill supply-chain security work that highlights resource-level vetting and runtime containment needs for skill ecosystems.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项重要的智能体技能供应链安全研究，强调了技能生态中资源级审查与运行时隔离的必要性。
